# Interests as the 2026-10-02 intelligence-pipeline run saw them (#2081).

Reduced replay profile: the topics of `~/obsidian/interests.md` (unchanged
since 2026-09-20, so it is the file that produced this day) carrying only the
keywords that actually matched at least one row of
`intel_survivors_2026-10-02.jsonl`. No `**Weight:**` is declared, exactly as in
the live file, so the loader's 1.0 default gives every admitted row
`keyword_score` 1.0 — the degeneracy that makes a keyword-only call budget a
measured no-op, and Alan's call to re-scale (#1380, ruled 2026-09-27).

It is a fixture rather than a read of the live file because the gate deselects
`live_vault` tests: interests.md is under a person's pen between rounds, and a
replay of one frozen day must not move with it.
